changeSet.comment: Supersede the P2.10 documents move rdr229-residue-catalog-documents while it is not complete (open or failed) and nothing supersedes it, and register the replacement rdr229-p31-residue-catalog-documents (RDR-229 P3.1 fix round B, nexus-p2m1x.17): one INSERT into nexus.data_moves. Its template is the old one with physical_collection_id = COALESCE(t.physical_collection_id, c.collection_id) added to the SET, so a row with a name and no id is repaired without the P3.1 CHECK refusing it (23514); its on_complete registers the replacement satellites rdr229-p31-residue-document-aspects and rdr229-p31-residue-document-highlights with changeset_id catalog-052-1, since the superseded move never runs its own. chunk_size 1000, sleep_ms 100, statement_timeout_ms 30000 (P2.10's): re-check budget 1130 ms = 2 x 390 ms + 7 tenants x 50 ms, so 30000 is 26.5x the budget. A completed documents move is left alone: the precondition is not met and the changeset is recorded as run, registering nothing. DATA EFFECT: at most one row added to the global registry nexus.data_moves (paused by catalog-052-4 where the old move was paused); the old move's row is not changed (it is superseded by the new row's supersedes) and no row of any other table changes at boot. The replacement, run by the engine after it serves, sets source_uri and physical_collection_id of the rows the P2.10 rule matches; the rollback unregisters the replacement and the satellites it registered, and does not undo a repair that ran.

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.17
changeSet.comment: Carry the pause of a superseded P2.10 documents move onto its replacement (RDR-229 P3.1 fix round B, nexus-p2m1x.17): when rdr229-p31-residue-catalog-documents supersedes a move that has paused_at set, it gets the same paused_at and paused_by, so a supersede does not lift an operator's hold (a down-step window, for one). It is a changeset of its own because the gate refuses a subselect in the documents INSERT of catalog-052-1 (r1.insert-select), and that INSERT has to stay a top-level INSERT ... VALUES for ShippedMoveRegistrations. It writes the registry row catalog-052-1 just registered and nothing else; with no replacement, or an unpaused old move, it changes no row. data-move-exempt: data_moves: the registry's own columns, not a table that grows with user data. DATA EFFECT: at most one row of the global registry nexus.data_moves, the replacement written by catalog-052-1 in the same walk, has paused_at and paused_by set; no row of any other table changes; reversible: the rollback clears the pause of that row.
changeSet.sql: DO $s$ BEGIN UPDATE nexus.data_moves n SET paused_at = o.paused_at, paused_by = o.paused_by FROM nexus.data_moves o WHERE n.label = 'rdr229-p31-residue-catalog-documents' AND n.supersedes = o.label AND o.paused_at IS NOT NULL; END $s$;
